post_headline: Your whole crew on one map.
post_subline: Start a group ride and share a code or QR. Track up to 12 riders on the map.
caption:
Holiday weekend, whole crew out on the dunes.
Start a group ride in Glamis Guide and track up to 12 riders on the map.
Share a QR code or a six-character code to invite them.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
